newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KNP BT Office Products to temper expansion.
newsitem.headline: KNP BT Office Products to temper expansion.

text.p: Dutch paper and office supplies group NV Koninklijke KNP BT said on Thursday it might scale down takeover activity at its fast-growing office products division.

"In office products we have to pay a lot of attention to the operational side of the business which needs to be improved, so it could be that the (takeover) activity will go to a somewhat lower level," KNP BT's financial director Rob Bonnier said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television.
Earlier this month KNP BT's 70-percent owned unit BT Office Products posted third quarter net income of $2.7 million, compared with 2.1 million in the year-ago period.
But the unit, which expanded in the U.S. and Europe mainly through takeovers, added its income gains were held back by a weak German market where operating margins had fallen.
It also said the cost structure at its New York division was not in line with the rest of the company.
KNP BT earlier posted a 1996 third quarter group net profit of 38 million guilders, sharply down from the 116 million in the same year-ago period but in line with analysts' forecasts.
It reiterated it expected net profit for the second half of 1996 to improve from the 101 million guilders posted in the first six months.
